style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cool autumn light; lamplight warm and small against the dark. No text, signature or border. Any people are tiny, far off, faces unseen.

beats.text: Shot: very wide, exterior, late night. A great Victorian asylum among tall old elms at Purfleet on 29 September 1893, all dark but one upper window glowing with lamplight where someone still works at papers, mist on the lawn, no moon.

Shot: wide, exterior, a grey October morning in 1893. A tall stately Georgian house on Piccadilly facing the trees of Green Park, its shutters closed and blinds down, empty and silent, hansom cabs and an omnibus passing in the street, gas lamps, wet pavement, pale haze.

Shot: far, exterior, night. The asylum at Purfleet in rain on 3 October 1893 seen from the dark garden: one tall ground-floor window warm with lamplight where small figures sit at a supper table, rain streaking the glass, black trees, no moon.

Shot: very wide, exterior, early grey morning on 5 October 1893. The asylum at Purfleet from across the lawn, frost on the grass, bare elms, one upper window faintly lit, rooks rising, a heavy still sky, no people.
Shot: very wide, by day. The broad Thames below Purfleet in October 1893, sailing barges and a steamer heading down river toward the sea, flat marshes, great grey clouds with light breaking through.
Shot: far, exterior, night. A bedroom window of the asylum on the first floor at night, a small lamp turned low behind the curtain, ivy on the old brick, the dark garden below, no moon, deep quiet.

Shot: very wide, exterior, night of 11 October 1893, no moon. The asylum at Purfleet dark against the stars, the one tall study window blazing with lamp and candle light, the black lawn and statue before it, solemn and still.

Shot: very wide, exterior, night, no moon. Across the black Thames marshes, the lights of the asylum at Purfleet small and far off, the river a dull gleam, a single ship's lantern moving down river toward the sea.

Shot: wide, exterior, Varna on the Black Sea in late October 1893, late afternoon: a quiet street of white houses with red tiled roofs sloping down to the harbour, a small railway station, the grey sea beyond, few people, autumn haze.

Shot: very wide, exterior, night. The harbour of Varna on the Black Sea in late October 1893 seen from a hotel balcony: dark water, a lighthouse beam, a few moored ships with riding lights, the long breakwater, the open sea black beyond, no moon.

Shot: wide, exterior, night. The quay at Galatz on the Danube on 30 October 1893: lamps along the wharf, steam launches and barges moored, warehouses, the broad dark river, a lit hotel window above, no moon.

Shot: very wide, exterior, a snowy November morning high in the Carpathians in 1893: a white valley under heavy cloud, a thin line of smoke rising from a tiny fire beside a small carriage and four horses far below, dark pines, mountains towering beyond.

Shot: very wide, exterior, late afternoon of 6 November 1893. A perfect desolation of snowy Carpathian mountains and gorges falling away eastward, a steep path winding down, the low sun breaking through cloud, the grim castle tiny on its crag far behind.
